scope: Pure assignment lifecycle and actual mapping-match policy; no GUI event suppression, actual WebMIDI or native/reference acceptance.

checks.name: Learning starts without a target and suppresses ordinary message dispatch
Choose/capture assigns once and retains unrelated mappings
Note release cannot become an assignment or trigger a command while learning
Unassign removes only the chosen target and stays ready for reassignment
Cancel clears arming and returns ordinary dispatch without creating a ghost mapping
Invalid target/encoding cannot corrupt existing assignments
Fourteen-bit continuous capture canonicalizes the actual pair and rejects unrelated CC
Rechoosing an already assigned input never duplicates its mapping
Explicit learned device scope rejects a different device while legacy mappings stay generic
